title: edits
description: The fixed edit vocabulary (43 ops in 6 classes), EditRecord and the designer menu row

BFlipbook.description: Changes through its drawn frames over time (seed, sprout, flower). The frame art is the library type's frames.
BFlipbook.title: BFlipbook

BNpc.description: A character that talks: touching it shows its lines one by one in a speech bubble.
BNpc.title: BNpc

BPhysics.description: A loose object that falls, slides, stacks and can be pushed. Boxes stay upright; balls roll.
BPhysics.title: BPhysics

BPickup.description: Something to collect. `item` names it for rules ("star"); `effect` is a ready-made rule fired on collect.
BPickup.title: BPickup

BPortal.description:
Touching a portal moves the player to its partner: the other portal with the same `pair` label in the level
(a lone portal does nothing).
BPortal.title: BPortal

BScripted.description: Runs the library type's script (a developer pack, app/spec/script.py).
BScripted.title: BScripted

BZone.description:
An area with an effect while the player is inside: wind and conveyor push toward `dir`, water slows and lets
you swim up, ice is slippery, low_gravity floats, slow halves speed. `strength` scales the effect.
BZone.title: BZone

Candidate.description: A designer menu row (§3.8): pre-verified in a sandbox, never raw geometry.
Candidate.title: Candidate

EditRecord.description: One edit with its status. Ids are stable: `op:target:hash6(params)` (D6).
EditRecord.title: EditRecord

EnemyParams.description: Archetype parameters (§5.7); every field optional, defaults live in core/params.ts.
EnemyParams.title: EnemyParams

MessageRef.description: A kid-facing sentence by key (shared/spec/messages.json); raw codes never reach the DOM.
MessageRef.title: MessageRef
